title: Sign/scale orbit across activations and normalization
hypothesis: Hidden-unit permutation is exact across tested elementwise activations and LayerNorm when norm affine parameters are permuted; positive nonuniform scaling with inverse outgoing compensation is exact only for ReLU; sign flips with inverse outgoing compensation are exact for tanh but not ReLU/GELU/LayerNorm+ReLU.
physical_object: one fixed 16-24-8 MLP per activation condition
mirror_coordinate: hidden-unit permutation or signed scale applied to first-layer coordinates with outgoing compensation
controls: hidden permutation with all associated affine parameters permuted
positive log-uniform per-unit scale plus inverse outgoing weight
signed per-unit scale plus inverse outgoing weight
success_gate: Permutation NRMSE <=1e-6 in all conditions; ReLU positive-scale and tanh sign-flip NRMSE <=1e-6; nonmatching activation/scale pairs NRMSE >1e-3.
failure_gate: Any preregistered exactness prediction fails or a purported non-symmetry remains <=1e-3 across fresh worlds.
boundaries: no trained task quality or task utility
